# Huy Bui

> Senior / Lead software engineer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Ten years building web platforms end to end across e-commerce, healthcare and insurance.

## Current role

Senior Software Engineer / Squad Lead at CoverGo (insurance, 2024—now). Leads and builds the low-code product builder that lets insurers configure health, life, property and casualty products. Cut time-to-market for a new insurance product from a month to a week. Delivered data anonymisation and deletion modules for regulatory compliance. Designed a workflow wrapper around Temporal for composable customer journeys. Won the 2024 Innovator Award at CoverGo.

## Experience history

- 2024—now: Senior Software Engineer / Squad Lead, CoverGo (Insurance) — Vue 3, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS, Temporal, Keycloak
- 2023: Technical Lead, National Innovation Center (Government) — Nuxt 3, NestJS, MongoDB, WordPress, AWS, Firebase
- 2021—2023: Senior Software Engineer, Pangara AB (Platform/CMS) — Vue.js, Node.js, Directus, Laravel, MySQL
- 2020—2021: Team Leader, ICD Vietnam (E-commerce) — Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Angular, Google App Engine
- 2018—2020: Solution Architect & Pre-sale, FPT Software (Healthcare) — PHP CodeIgniter, Vue.js, Laravel, Node.js, AWS Serverless, Swift
- 2016—2018: Senior Software Engineer, NTT DATA (Healthcare) — Java, Spring MVC, Oracle, Terasoluna
- 2015: Software Programmer, FPT Information System (Enterprise/SAP) — SAP ABAP

## Selected projects

- Government Event Website & Registration (https://hanoiconvention.org): CMS and online registration for the UN Convention against Cybercrime signing ceremony in Hanoi. WordPress, Next.js, NestJS, K8s.
- Booking & Reservation Module (https://kasha.io): Booking module backend, architected from inception to MVP launch. NestJS, gRPC, RabbitMQ, Postgres.
- Insurance Product Builder (https://covergo.com): Low-code builder for insurers to configure products with minimal code. Vue 3, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Keycloak.
- Breezing.in - Event Management Platform (https://breezing.in): All-in-one event and booking platform, built as founding engineer. Nuxt 3, NestJS, MongoDB, AWS.
- Business Connect - Matchmaking Platform (https://nic.gov.vn): Business matchmaking platform for Vietnam International Innovation Expo 2023. Nuxt 3, NestJS, MongoDB, AWS.
- Dental AI Imaging Project: AI-powered imaging tool and microservices dental platform. PHP, Vue.js, Laravel, AWS Serverless.

## Stack

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Java. Frontend: Vue 3, Nuxt, React, Next.js, TailwindCSS, Vuetify, PrimeVue. Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Laravel, Spring MVC. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle. Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Grafana, OpenTelemetry. Integration: REST, GraphQL, gRPC, RabbitMQ, Temporal. AI & Testing: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Jest, Playwright.
